title: Workspace Persistence & Sidebar Improvements
description: Introduces connection-aware workspace persistence, a new sidebar toggle for switching between tables and saved tabs, and safety features for unsaved work.
highlights: Sidebar toggle for Tables and Tabs

items.title: Workspace Persistence
items.description: Tabs (chats, spreadsheets, queries) are now saved per database connection.
details: Tabs automatically restore when switching back to a connection
Real-time state synchronization with backend persistence
Auto-save mechanism to prevent data loss

items.title: Sidebar Improvements
items.description: Enhanced navigation with a new toggle in the connection list.
details: Switch between database table view and saved tabs view
Manage active tabs directly from the sidebar
Compact TabList component for quick switching

items.title: Migration & Safety
items.description: Ensuring data integrity during workspace transitions.
details: Visual warning when working in the Temporary Workspace
Migration dialog prompts to move or discard unsaved tabs when switching connections

items.title: Backend Services
items.description: New infrastructure for user session management.
details: Connection-workspaces database table for persistent storage
WorkspaceService for handling loading and migration logic
